atoms.1: A flu test is the same as an influenza test.
atoms.2: Both terms refer to diagnostic tests used to detect the presence of the influenza virus in a patient.
atoms.3: Influenza is commonly known as the flu.
atoms.4: Influenza is caused by influenza viruses.
atoms.5: Flu tests help in identifying the specific virus strain responsible for the infection.
atoms.6: Influenza tests help in identifying the specific virus strain responsible for the infection.

snippets.output: A flu test is the same as an influenza test; both terms refer to diagnostic tests used to detect the presence of the influenza virus.
Influenza is commonly known as the flu and is caused by influenza viruses.
Flu tests help identify the specific influenza virus strain responsible for the infection.
Influenza tests help identify the specific virus strain responsible for the infection.
